# Uoink v3.10.0
A local library for the videos and podcasts you study, that any AI you use can search and cite.

## What it does
- Capture YouTube videos with transcripts, frames, and comments.
- Save X posts and videos, podcasts, articles, and Reddit threads.
- Keep everything on your disk as Markdown + JSON, with a local search index.
- Let your AI search the library and cite timestamps.
- Run five local research playbooks on your saved sources.
- Get writing help in your voice with Voice DNA and Writing Studio.

## Set it up with an agent (Windows 10/11)
Windows 10/11 only. No Mac build scheduled. Uoink v3.10.0 is free and MIT-licensed; the unsigned installer is about 390 MB. No admin rights needed.
[Agent installation steps](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/blob/main/llms-install.md): download, verify SHA-256, install, and connect.
### An agent can run
1. Download [Uoink-Setup-3.10.0.exe](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/download/v3.10.0/Uoink-Setup-3.10.0.exe) to `$env:TEMP\Uoink-Setup-3.10.0.exe`.
2. Before running it, compare `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 "$env:TEMP\Uoink-Setup-3.10.0.exe"` with the installer entry in [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/download/v3.10.0/SHA256SUMS.txt).
3. Install per user: `Start-Process -Wait -FilePath "$env:TEMP\Uoink-Setup-3.10.0.exe" -ArgumentList '/VERYSILENT','/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES','/NORESTART'`. It installs to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink` with Add the uoink command to PATH for AI agents checked by default. No data or settings changes besides the optional PATH entry; no new index or migration. Installing over the previous release keeps the library and saved captures.
4. Open a new terminal, run `uoink status`, then connect a client below. Silent install does not start Uoink; MCP works without it running. For the dashboard, browser button, and monitored-playlist polling, start "Uoink" from the Start menu or run `& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Uoink\python\pythonw.exe" "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Uoink\server.py"` in PowerShell.
### The person must do
- Allow the unsigned installer if Windows asks. For SmartScreen, choose More info, then Run anyway.
- For the optional browser button: open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and select %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink\extension. An agent can capture without the button.
Chrome (tested); other Chromium browsers such as Edge and Brave may work but are not tested.
Click the puzzle-piece Extensions icon in the toolbar and pin Uoink so the Uoink button stays visible.
- After updating, reload the extension once. If its ID changes to bkcapfidedhfcjpmjabeopfbcjcbmdmi, reapply extension preferences; saved captures are unaffected.

## Connect your AI
Official MCP registry: io.github.ryanbiddy/uoink
- Setup recipes: `uoink connect --list` prints setup choices for 38 clients and integrations. Run `uoink connect <client>` for config or instructions and their destination; it does not edit client settings. Run the printed Claude Code command in PowerShell; merge other clients' entries into the location shown, then restart their MCP connection.
- Codex: `uoink connect codex` prints tables for `~/.codex/config.toml`. VS Code: `uoink connect vscode` prints config for `.vscode/mcp.json`. The dashboard's Add to Cursor / Add to VS Code buttons open the client's review flow; acceptance of these buttons is not yet tested.
- Uoink skill for Claude Code, Codex, pi, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw: `uoink skill path` locates it; `uoink skill install --to <dir>` copies it with references into a uoink subfolder of the parent skills directory. Restart the agent or reload its skills.
- Claude Code plugin for a default install: `claude plugin marketplace add ryanbiddy/uoink-agent-kit`, then `claude plugin install uoink@uoink`. Restart Claude Code and enable the plugin MCP server when prompted. Custom installs use `uoink connect claude-code` plus the standalone skill; avoid duplicate MCP entries.
- CLI examples: `uoink search "working memory" --limit 5`, `uoink recent --limit 10`, `uoink note "A useful thought" --title "Research note"`. Agents can search sources, read evidence, capture URLs, save notes, and call registry tools. Local reads work without the helper running; capture and paid tools keep their existing gates. The agent must be able to execute Uoink on the Windows machine holding the library.
Tested on a clean, isolated install: Claude Code 2.1.302 over MCP (all 91 tools listed; a note saved and listed back); Claude Code with the skill and CLI only (skill loaded; uoink note and uoink recent ran); Codex CLI 0.153.4 over MCP (a note saved and listed back); CLI status, note, recent, and connect. The Claude Code plugin loads its skill and starts its MCP server; its tool calls were not run end to end because the test install is isolated from a normal one. Not yet tested: Gemini CLI and pi (no sign-in on the test machine) and every other uoink connect recipe. Claude Desktop and Cursor retain their earlier MCP testing status.
- Claude Desktop: download and open [uoink-3.10.0.mcpb](https://github.com/ryanbiddy/uoink/releases/download/v3.10.0/uoink-3.10.0.mcpb) for one-click setup. It installs as an extension and asks for the Uoink folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink). Enter the full path; Desktop does not expand %LOCALAPPDATA%. Reinstall the bundle and restart Desktop after updating.
- Claude Code (verified with 2.1.302): run in PowerShell: `claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio uoink -e PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 -e PYTHONUTF8=1 -- "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Uoink\python\python.exe" "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Uoink\uoink_mcp.py"`.
- Cursor: use the config below and add `"UOINK_MCP_TOOLSET": "core"` to the server env for the previous 35-tool set. Cursor is reported to send only the first 40 tools to its agent; core stays under that cap.
- Other stdio clients: use this config with absolute paths. Full mode is the default. Cline and Continue were not individually smoke-tested.
`{"mcpServers": {"uoink": {"command": "%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Uoink\\python\\python.exe", "args": ["%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Uoink\\uoink_mcp.py"], "env": {"PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8", "PYTHONUTF8": "1"}}}}`
Replace %LOCALAPPDATA% in both JSON paths with your full app-data directory; restart the client after saving. See the release testing notes above.
- ChatGPT and claude.ai: copy and paste only; Uoink does not connect to the ChatGPT app over MCP.

## Tools
91 tools over stdio and 91 in the HTTP registry. Every tool is on both transports; consent gates are unchanged.
- Capture: video, playlists, podcasts, pages, X, Reddit, notes, and images.
- Search and citations: library search, clips, evidence cards, chapters, and cited range export.
- Research: playbook packets from local sources and optional paid discovery.
- Writing: Voice DNA, drafts, scripts, and writing checks.
- Workspaces: saved projects and context for your agent.
- Library and sources: queue work, subscriptions, and source consent. Librarian applying is off by default; its quality gate has not passed.
[Tool manifest and schemas](https://uoink.app/mcp/manifest.json).

## Privacy in brief
- Local-first: captures and indexes stay on disk; capture requests contact source sites.
- No account or Uoink-hosted corpus.
- Optional AI calls use your own key. Allowed agents can start paid calls even when automatic analysis is off.
- ScrapeCreators discovery is off by default, uses your own key, and defaults to a 25-credit daily cap; paid calls need credit confirmation and consent.
- Discovery run files are purged daily when older than 90 days.
- Model dependencies can send telemetry. Model downloads, thumbnails, and release checks can also contact outside services; this website uses Vercel Web Analytics.
Full disclosures: [llms-full.txt](https://uoink.app/llms-full.txt) and [Privacy](https://uoink.app/privacy).
